title: Missing epoch u32 mask causes OverflowError on edge cases
description:
File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:86

epoch.to_bytes(4, 'little') without masking; negative or >2^32 epoch raises OverflowError instead of wrapping.

**Failure scenario:** select_channel(eui64, epoch=-1, density=0) raises OverflowError. The ccp.py implementation correctly masks with (epoch & 0xFFFFFFFF).

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
